AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 4, 2020
REGULAR MEETING
  6:15 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Margarita L. Rios, Mayor
  Luigi Vernola, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Jennifer Perez, Councilmember
  Leonard Shryock, Councilmember
 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
 the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
 minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
 matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
 has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  2.  BurgerIM Grand Opening Recap.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT
 CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of
  January 21, 2020. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period December 29, 2019 –
  January 11, 2020, in the total amount of $926,482.38. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  January 15, 2020 through January 29, 2020, in the total amount of $3,519,400.06. 640

  Warrant Register

  4.  CLAIMS AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claims filed by Emelia Alfaro
  and Maria Paloma-Alfaro, Mercury Insurance (Rachel Neal), and Gasper Munoz. 830-01/13

  Report

  5.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – JANUARY 22, 2020 – Receive and File. 320

  Report

  6.  ORDINANCE NO. 20-1714 - ADOPTING ZONE CHANGE NO. 360 AND ORDINANCE NO. 20-1715 –
  ADOPTING DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT - MERCY HOUSING PROJECT – Staff recommends City
  Council accept for second reading and adopt:

  a.  Ordinance No. 20-1714, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK SETTING FORTH ITS
  FINDINGS OF FACT AND DECISION APPROVING ZONE CHANGE NO. 360; and

  b.  Ordinance No. 20-1715, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING A LEASE
  AND APPROVING AND ADOPTING A DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT WITH MERCY HOUSING
  CALIFORNIA RELATED TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE +/- 1.5 ACRE PROPERTY AT
  SAN ANTONIO DRIVE AND FOSTER ROAD; AND MAKING FINDINGS CONSISTENT WITH
  AND PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 65867.5. 320-09-360/920-11/1405-01

  Report

  7.  CONFIRM EMERGENCY WORK – REPLACEMENT OF TRAFFIC SIGNAL POLES AT ROSECRANS
  AVENUE/FLALLON AVENUE AND FIRESTONE BOULEVARD/SAN ANTONIO DRIVE - Staff
  recommends City Council confirm emergency repair work for two locations completed by Siemens
  Mobility Inc., in the amount of $15,115.52. 955

  Report

  8.  CONFIRM EMERGENCY WORK – REPAIR OF WATER MAIN LINE AT 11937 166TH STREET - Staff
  recommends City Council confirm emergency repair work completed by Precision Pipeline Inc., in the
  amount of $16,914.91. 955

  Report

  9.  REQUEST FOR USE OF CIVIC CENTER LAWN FOR CARNIVAL - Staff recommends City Council
  approve the carnival requested by the Lions Club for the dates of May 21 through May 25, 2020 and
  waive the security deposit as requested consistent with past practice. 920-01-02

  Report

  10. AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 1 – ON-CALL COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT
   CONSULTING SERVICES – Staff recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 1 to the
  agreement with Michael Baker International, Inc. dated July 1, 2019, to provide on-call CBDG
  consulting services in an amount not to exceed $73,360; and authorize the City Manager to execute
  the agreement and any additional amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the
  City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 315

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  11. ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

  12. APPROVE SELECTION OF PERSONNEL APPEALS BOARD MEMBERS FOR UPCOMING APPEAL
  HEARING - Staff recommends City Council approve the Mayor’s Personnel Appeals Board selections
  and the backup member should it be necessary. 255-01

  Report

REPORTS

  13. RESOLUTION NO. 20-10 – BUDGET AMENDMENT - CITY PROJECT NO. 7228, FEDERAL
  PROJECT NO. HSIPL-5347 (038) – AWARD OF CONTRACT - TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS
  ON ROSECRANS AVENUE, STUDEBAKER ROAD TO CARMENITA ROAD - ENGINEERS REPORT
  NO. 20-05 – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-10, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE GAS TAX – HIGHWAY USERS TAX SECTION 2103 FUNDS FOR
  PROJECT NO. 7228 – TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS ALONG ROSECRANS AVENUE
  FROM STUDEBAKER ROAD TO CARMENITA ROAD, in the amount of $948,000; and

  b.  award a contract to Select Electric, Inc. for Project No. 7228 Traffic Signal Improvements along
  Rosecrans Avenue in the amount of $1,690,225; and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  contract, and any amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a
  form approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7228

  Report

  14. RESOLUTION NO. 20-11 – BUDGET AMENDMENT- CITY PROJECT NO. 7230, FEDERAL PROJECT
  NO. HSIPL-5347 (040) – AWARD OF CONTRACT - TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS ON SAN
  ANTONIO DRIVE/NORWALK BOULEVARD AND ON CIVIC CENTER DRIVE – ENGINEERS
  REPORT NO. 20-06 – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-11, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE MEASURE R FUNDS FOR PROJECT NO. 7230 – TRAFFIC
  SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS ON SAN ANTONIO DRIVE/NORWALK BOULEVARD AND ON CIVIC
  CENTER DRIVE, in the amount of $404,950; and

  b.  award a contract to Dynalectric for Project No. 7230, Traffic Signal Improvements on San Antonio
  Drive and on Civic Center Drive in the amount of $950,814; and authorize the City Manager to
  execute the contract and any amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the
  City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7230

  Report

  15. RESOLUTION NO. 20-12 – BUDGET AMENDMENT - CITY PROJECT NO. 7923 – AWARD OF
  CONTRACT – COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT FUNDED LOCAL STREET
  REHABILITATION – ENGINEERS REPORT NO. 20-07 – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-12, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
   NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) FUNDS
  AND TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT (TDA) ARTICLE 3 FUNDS FOR PROJECT NO.
  7923 - CDBG FUNDED LOCAL STREET REHABILITATION, in the amount of $24,000 and
  $46,600, respectively; and

  b.  award a contract to R.J. Noble Company for CDBG funded Local Street Rehabilitation in the
  amount of $521,007; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract and any
  amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney.
  1005-04-7923

  Report

  16. DISCUSSION OF PICKUP AND DROP OFF CIRCULATION FROM STUDEBAKER SCHOOL SITE
  ONTO STUDEBAKER ROAD - Provided for City Council information.

  Report

  17. MARCH 3, 2020 CITY COUNCIL MEETING – Staff requests City Council direction.

  Report

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated January 31, 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
